1935, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 26 Cont.
Aug. 7
Fr. J. Hoffernan - 77 - trying
8 Floyd McSweyn - now 24 - of Merrill, Mich - in May 1933 fell 18 feet on cement floor receiving to all reasoning fatal skull fracture and other injuries. His mother, sick at time, got out of bed and phoned to have him enrolled ... She tells us To-day that Fr. - assured her "the boy will be better inside of five-hours ... Blind and dumb and totally paralyzed at time mother phoned, asked for a smoke after. He had completely and perfectly recovered - save hearing in one ear.
Page 27
Aug. John and Robert Evans - 6 & 3 - infantile paralysis or similar. John received Bapt. privately as infant. Father raised Catholic, Mother Episcopelian. Rob. not baptized at all.
11 Ed. Lutz - 34 gall-bl. & hernia - has wife and 3 small ch. - opera- tion decided on to-morrow - pains for 20 yrs. - very severe for 4.
13 Sam. Cataldo - 24 - Operation for T.B. July 17 - 4 Ribs removed. To- morrow another operation expected to take 3 or 6. Parents away from Conf. & Com. over 3 mo. Promise to go tomorrow.
14 Rose Desinger - 63 - threatened cataracts.
Page 28 Aug . Harry & Clare Myers - have four small- Mother presbiterian - father atheist. He has fearful head-aches, etc. She believes in God. She has been studying "Unity" and praying ... but no results. Enrolls herself and husband To-day.
Dr. R. non C. - asks prayers - domestic Frank Liss - 41 - throat-cancer has 6 children & wife depending ... Wm. Meyer - 10% - adopted since infancy - inclined to be very wayward ... . Enrolled To-day 50c
Ed. Griffith - 56 - 3 rd Stroke March 1 - slowly improving .....
Page 29 Aug. 18 S.P. Gallagher - Cold Water, Mich. - dying of Cancer. Enrolled some weeks ago. Seemed set against going to confession, was enrolled & on July 17th prayers were asked. Aug. 10 made his confession and now is ready .... Deo Gr.
